name: Sri Lanka
title: Investor Visa Category
instrument: Department of Immigration and Emigration, 'Investor Visa Category' guideline (undated PDF). Investment vehicles governed by Regulation No. 02 of 2021 under the Foreign Exchange Act No. 12 of 2017; company investments under the Companies Act No. 7 of 2007.
notes: Read 2026-07-30 via pdftotext on the official PDF. Tiers: USD 100,000 = 5-year visa; USD 200,000 = 10-year visa (issued initially as 5 years, then a departmental extension letter). Funds must move through an Inward Investment Account (IIA) then a Visa Programme Foreign Currency Account (VPFCA) at a licensed commercial bank. Permitted investments: voting shares (min 10% of voting capital), overseas-company place of business, 5-year+ GoSL/CBSL debt securities, LCB term deposits, immovable property. Fee USD 200/year for applicant, spouse and each dependant. Project reviewed every 2 years by the Investigation Division. NOT verified: the gazette/regulation number creating the visa category, its commencement date, and whether time held counts toward permanent residence. Quote uses an EN DASH (U+2013) between the amount and 'for'.

name: Sri Lanka
title: Golden Paradise Residence Visa
instrument: Department of Immigration and Emigration, 'Golden Paradise Visa' official brochure (undated PDF). Described on the brochure as 'a special category of Residence Visa'.
notes: Read 2026-07-30 via pdftotext on the official brochure PDF. Requires opening a Golden Paradise Foreign Currency Account (GPFCA) at a bank recognised by the Central Bank of Sri Lanka. Validity 10 years; visa fee USD 200 per annum with the full 10-year total payable up front. Investor may withdraw up to 50% of the minimum after completion of the first year from issuance. Permitted uses: condominium purchase, Sri Lanka Development Bonds, other government-approved investments, leasing land and buildings. Spouse and dependants eligible. A second official page carries the same figure with DIFFERENT wording ('Open a Golden Paradise Foreign Currency Account (GPFCA) and deposit minimum of USD 200,000') at https://eservices.immigration.gov.lk/golden-paradise-visa.html — use the brochure quote above when re-fetch checking. NOT verified: launch/effective date, creating gazette or regulation, whether the withdrawn 50% must remain in Sri Lanka, renewal terms after year 10.

name: Sri Lanka
title: Digital Nomad Visa (DNV)
quote_original: Minimum monthly income remittance of USD 2,000 for the main applicant
instrument: Department of Immigration and Emigration, 'Digital Nomad Visa Category' guideline (undated PDF). Cabinet approved the concept in 2023; visa became operational in early 2026.
notes: Read 2026-07-30 via pdftotext on the official PDF. Additional USD 500/month per dependant beyond two. Duration '01 year', renewable annually; extension requires proof of Inland Revenue Department tax registration. Fee USD 500/year for main applicant, spouse and each dependant. Requires a recommendation from the Ministry of Digital Economy, international health insurance, medical and police clearance. Local employment prohibited. STALE-FIGURE FLAG: heavy secondary reporting (CNBC, Fragomen, BAL, nomad sites) claims the threshold was cut to USD 1,500/month and validity extended to 5 years effective 15 January 2026. That change could NOT be verified on any official source — the official guideline still states USD 2,000 and 01 year as at 2026-07-30. Re-checkers should look for a superseding gazette. Also NOT verified: the gazette notification number.

name: Sri Lanka
title: Resident Guest Scheme (RGS)
quote_original: This visa category only issues foreigners those who are already obtained this visa (extension only).
instrument: Department of Immigration and Emigration, Resident Guest Scheme Visa Programme page, headed 'Extension only for the existing visa holders'.
notes: Read 2026-07-30. NOT an absence claim: the scheme exists and is live for renewals, but the department's own page restricts issuance to existing holders, so it is closed to new applicants. Figures on the same page: investor category minimum US$ 250,000/= in a foreign currency account plus US$ 35,000/= per dependant; professional category US$ 2,000/= monthly for the applicant and US$ 1,000/= monthly per dependant. Visa issued one year at a time to a five-year maximum; fee US$ 200 per person per year. Board of Investment approves investor projects. Blank application form at http://www.immigration.gov.lk/content/files/visa/ResidentGuestScheme.pdf (form only, no substantive terms). NOT verified: the date new intake stopped, or whether a gazette formally closed the scheme.

name: Sri Lanka
title: My Dream Home Visa Programme
quote_original: US$15000 or the equivalent in an approved foreign currency
instrument: Department of Immigration and Emigration, My Dream Home Visa Programme page, headed 'Extension only for the existing visa holders'.
notes: Read 2026-07-30. Not an absence claim — the programme exists and is live for renewals but the page restricts issuance to existing holders. Requirements: fixed deposit of US$15,000 (or approved foreign-currency equivalent) in a Sri Lankan bank, plus monthly remittance of US$ 1,500 for the principal and US$ 750 for each spouse and dependent child (under 18 and unmarried). Visa valid two years, renewable; fee USD 200 per year for each applicant, spouse and dependent child over 16. Half-yearly bank statements required. Commonly described externally as a retirement visa, but the official page states no minimum age. NOT verified: the date new intake stopped, or the underlying gazette.

name: Sri Lanka
title: Colombo Port City investor / residential property lessee visas
quote_original: Applicants may enter Sri Lanka using the issued Landing Endorsement and must obtain the resident visa within 30 days of arrival.
instrument: Colombo Port City Economic Commission Act No. 11 of 2021 (named on the page); CPCEC acts as single-window investment facilitator.
notes: Read 2026-07-30. Confirmed on the official gov.lk domain that Investor, Business, Employee and Residential Property Lessee visa categories exist and a resident visa is issued; applications go to applications@portcity.gov.lk and the stated fee is USD 200 per annum. HOW FAR I GOT: category existence and process confirmed. WHAT IS MISSING: the official page publishes no minimum investment, no minimum lease value and no visa duration for the Investor or Residential Property Lessee categories, and I did not locate the implementing gazette regulation. NEXT STEP: search documents.gov.lk for CPCEC visa regulations made under Act No. 11 of 2021, and retry per-category sub-pages (https://www.portcitycolombo.gov.lk/visas/resident-visa returned HTTP 404 on 2026-07-30). Threshold is unknown, not absent.

name: Ukraine
title: Temporary residence permit for founders / participants / beneficial owners
instrument: Law of Ukraine 'On the Legal Status of Foreigners and Stateless Persons' No. 3773-VI; procedure under Cabinet of Ministers Resolution No. 322 of 25 April 2018.
notes: Read 2026-07-30 on the State Migration Service English site. Ground: founder and/or participant and/or beneficial owner (controller) of a legal entity registered in Ukraine whose share of ownership, or the controlled foreign legal entity's share, in the authorised capital is not less than EUR 100,000 at the NBU official rate on the date the foreign investment is made. Permit validity TWO years for this category (one year for most other grounds). Permit blank fee UAH 654. Wartime context: martial law since 24 Feb 2022; CMU Resolution No. 1202 of 21 Oct 2022 governs migration procedure under martial law, amended by CMU Resolution No. 141 of 5 Feb 2026 which per SECONDARY reporting restored standard procedures and opened a 90-day exchange window (reported 7 May – 4 Aug 2026) — the Res. 141 detail is NOT verified on an official page. The SMS page carries no notice of suspension. NOT verified: which amending law inserted the EUR 100,000 ground, practical processing times, whether this permit counts toward an immigration permit. DISTINCT from the USD 100,000 permanent-residence route — different currency, statute and outcome.

name: Ukraine
title: Immigration permit for investors (permanent residence)
quote_original: особи, які здійснили іноземну інвестицію в економіку України іноземною конвертованою валютою на суму не менше 100 (ста) тисяч доларів США
instrument: Law of Ukraine 'On Immigration' No. 2491-III of 7 June 2001, Article 4 (Стаття 4. Квота імміграції), within-quota category.
notes: Read 2026-07-30 on zakon.rada.gov.ua; consolidated text shown current as of 16 Jan 2026, last amended by Law No. 4502-IX. IMPORTANT: quote is from the /print view — the plain https://zakon.rada.gov.ua/laws/show/2491-14 URL returned only the portal shell without article text, so re-fetch the /print URL. Corroborated by the State Migration Service at https://dmsu.gov.ua/en-home/services/documenting-foreigners/obtaining-immigration-permit.html, which lists the same USD 100,000 investment category among eight within-quota groups and states the statutory decision period does not exceed one year. Quotas set annually by the Cabinet of Ministers and split by region. Outcome is permanent residence. NOT verified: the current-year quota figure or resolution number, and whether any quota is actually allocated to the investment category for 2026 — the biggest open question on this route.

name: Ukraine
title: Immigration permit for highly qualified specialists and workers
quote_original: висококваліфіковані спеціалісти і робітники, гостра потреба в яких є відчутною для економіки України
instrument: Law of Ukraine 'On Immigration' No. 2491-III of 7 June 2001, Article 4, within-quota category.
notes: Read 2026-07-30 on zakon.rada.gov.ua /print view. Grants permanent residence directly rather than an employer-sponsored work permit, so it belongs in the atlas as a talent route rather than an excluded work permit. A parallel within-quota category covers figures in science and culture whose immigration is in Ukraine's interests. Statutory wording is qualitative so the practical bar is unknown. NOT verified: the list of occupations in 'acute demand', the evidentiary standard, the annual quota allocated, and whether the SMS is processing these during martial law. Separately, as a note and not a row: Ukraine's 'e-Residency' scheme is a tax/business registration facility and confers no right of residence — it should not be mistaken for an immigration route.
